papers.title: Parallel processing of sensory cue and spatial information in the dentate gyrus.

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic AAV injection (GCaMP6s) into dorsal dentate gyrus and imaging window/headpost implantation

parameters.coordinates: -2 mm AP, -1.5 mm ML, three DV depths relative to cortical surface

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GCaMP6s-expressing dentate gyrus granule cells, chronic imaging window
pipeline_steps.source_quote: unilaterally injected with recombinant adeno-associated virus

pipeline_steps.technique: Water-restricted head-fixed treadmill training with cue-less then multi-modal-cue belts and randomly located reward zones

parameters.cues: odor (isoamyl acetate), visual (LED), tactile (sandpaper on whiskers)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing the sensory-cue treadmill task
pipeline_steps.hardware: Arduino DUE, OpenMaze OM4 PCB, RFID reader (SparkFun ID12LA)
pipeline_steps.source_quote: underwent a water restriction scheme (1ml per day)

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of dentate gyrus granule cells during the sensory-cue spatial task
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw dentate gyrus calcium imaging movies
pipeline_steps.hardware: Nikon NIR Apo 40x objective, Hamamatsu 7422P-40 PMT
pipeline_steps.source_quote: 8kHz resonant galvanometer (Bruker) mounted to a mirror

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging preprocessing: NoRMCorre motion correction, CNMF/CaImAn or Suite2p ROI extraction, Cellpose cell counting, custom transient detection

parameters.downsampling: spatial and temporal 2x downsampling before segmentation
parameters.transient_threshold: rise slope > 4 SD above iteratively refined baseline

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected ROIs and detected calcium transients
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Movies were motion corrected using NoRMCorre algorithm

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially-tuned cells and classification into middle-cue, lap-cue, and place-cell subtypes

parameters.criteria: firing above 99% of shuffled distribution for >=5 consecutive spatial bins

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified cue-cell and place-cell populations
pipeline_steps.source_quote: spatially selective cell was defined that met the following criteria

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial information, tuning consistency, and place/cue-field onset-lap analysis
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial information scores, field onset laps

pipeline_steps.technique: Multi-session cell tracking (modified CellReg) and population-vector/rate-correlation remapping analysis

parameters.modification: source code modified to use complete spatial footprints instead of centroids

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-session-registered cells, PV/rate correlations
pipeline_steps.source_quote: we modified the CellReg source code to consider complete spatial footprints

pipeline_steps.technique: Bayesian position-reconstruction decoding from population calcium activity

parameters.cross_validation: 1/5 of laps held out as test set

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded animal position, decoding error
pipeline_steps.source_quote: used a previously published method based on Bayesian reconstruction

pipeline_steps.technique: Cue-shift, spatial-modulation, and lateral-inhibition analyses of granule-cell cue responses

parameters.spatial_modulation: ratio of non-preferred to preferred cue-location firing rate

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial modulation index, inhibition magnitude
pipeline_steps.source_quote: cross-correlated with firing rates on shift laps

pipeline_steps.technique: General non-parametric statistical hypothesis testing across experiments

parameters.test_type: non-parametric tests, no assumptions on data distribution

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

papers.title: Adult-born granule cells facilitate remapping of spatial and non-spatial representations in the dentate gyrus.

pipeline_steps.technique: Focal hippocampal X-irradiation to ablate adult neurogenesis while sparing other neurogenic regions

parameters.anesthesia: ketamine (105 mg/kg i.p.) and xylazine (7 mg/kg i.p.)
parameters.shielding: lead plate with a 3.22 x 11 mm window over the hippocampus
parameters.schedule: cumulative dose of 5 Gy over 2 min 47 sec, on 3 days with 2-3 days between sessions
parameters.controls: handled, anesthetized, and transported identically but not irradiated
parameters.downstream_delay: injection and window implant performed 8 weeks later

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic AAV-GCaMP injection into dorsal dentate gyrus followed by chronic imaging window and headpost implantation

parameters.coordinates: -2 mm AP, -1.5 mm ML, -1.8/-1.7/-1.55 mm DV relative to cortical surface
parameters.injection_volume: 30 nl per DV location in 10 nl increments, 1:3 diluted virus
parameters.window: 2 mm stainless-steel cannula bonded to a 2 mm glass coverslip, secured with dental cement
parameters.craniotomy: 2 mm diameter, centered on injection site

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging perfusion, cryosectioning, immunohistochemistry, and confocal imaging to validate viral expression and cell markers

parameters.primary_antibodies: goat anti-Doublecortin (1:500), chicken anti-EGFP (1:1000), rabbit anti-DsRed (1:500)
parameters.confocal_settings: Leica TCS SP8, dry 20x objective (0.70 NA, 0.5 mm WD), 10-15 optical Z sections at 2 um spacing

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal fluorescence image stacks of stained tissue sections

pipeline_steps.technique: Design of a head-fixed treadmill behavioral apparatus with microcontroller-driven reward delivery, lick sensing, and lap tracking

parameters.treadmill: 2 m long, 7.5 cm wide cotton fabric belt on laser-cut plastic wheels
parameters.controller: Arduino DUE with OpenMaze OM4 PCB
parameters.position_tracking: quadrature rotary encoder (US Digital MA3-A10-125-B) plus RFID lap-counting chip/reader (Sparkfun ID12LA)
parameters.reward_delivery: solenoid valve (Parker Hannefin), 2-3 ul drops, operant on tongue contact for up to 3 sec in reward zone
parameters.monitoring: IR camera (PS3eye) with IR LED array illumination

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized position, lick, and reward event traces
pipeline_steps.hardware: Arduino DUE / OpenMaze OM4 PCB behavioral rig

pipeline_steps.technique: Water-restriction habituation and treadmill running training with progressively reduced reward frequency

parameters.initial_training: 20 randomly placed rewards per lap, decreased until mice ran reliably for 3 rewards/lap at >=1 lap/min
parameters.belt_progression: cue-less burlap belt, then a cued belt with distinct modalities
parameters.contamination_control: belt material changed between sessions and washed with Tergazyme

pipeline_steps.technique: Context-switching paradigm with cue-cell and place-cell classification based on spatial field position relative to tactile/olfactory cues

parameters.task: 3 randomly placed hidden water rewards per lap on cue-rich belts, contexts A and B sharing belt structure but differing in visual/auditory/tactile/olfactory cues
parameters.olfactory_delivery: ambient tube (X-irradiation cohort) or solenoid-gated airflow (silencing cohort), isoamyl acetate or menthalactone
parameters.cue_cell_definition: peak spatial field within defined bin ranges corresponding to tactile cue locations (or the 50th-55th bin for the odor cue)
parameters.place_cell_definition: remaining spatially tuned cells not meeting the cue-cell criterion

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell cue-cell / place-cell classification labels

pipeline_steps.technique: Cue-manipulation paradigm on a motorized belt with omit/shift trials, classifying odor-cue, lap-cue, and place cells

parameters.motorization: 12V DC gear motor on treadmill axle via Arduino/OpenMaze pulse-width modulation
parameters.cue_manipulation: 10-20% of laps had the mid-track odor cue omitted or shifted forward 1/4 of track length
parameters.odor_cue_cell_definition: spatial field overlapping >=50% of the 45th-55th bins with peak amplitude >=2x that on cue-omitted laps
parameters.lap_cue_cell_definition: spatial field overlapping >=50% of the region wrapping the 90th-10th bins, peak amplitude in omit/shift laps not exceeding 2x that in normal laps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell odor-cue / lap-cue / place-cell classification labels

pipeline_steps.technique: Goal-oriented learning (GOL) paradigm with a reward-location reversal session, scored by normalized lick rate

parameters.belt_cues: 10 cm velcro band at lap boundary; 10 cm soft circular material at belt midpoint
parameters.training_sessions: two training sessions with a fixed 20 cm hidden reward zone at the 90-110 cm position
parameters.reversal_session: reward zone moved to 40-60 cm position, other belt features unchanged
parameters.performance_metric: lick count normalized to occupancy per bin, in a 20 cm anticipatory window and a 20 cm reward/goal window

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-session normalized lick-rate performance curves

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of dentate granule cells through a chronic window

parameters.laser: Chameleon Ultra II (Coherent), 920 nm, 20-40 mW average power at back focal plane
parameters.objective: 40x water immersion (Nikon NIR Apo, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD)
parameters.head_angle_adjustment: two goniometers (Edmund Optics) for cross-session plane matching

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw GCaMP fluorescence time series
pipeline_steps.hardware: Prairie Technologies multi-photon microscope; Hamamatsu 7422P-40 PMT

pipeline_steps.technique: Non-rigid motion correction with spatial/temporal downsampling of two-photon movies

parameters.registration_method: non-rigid, field of view split into overlapping patches registered separately then merged by smooth interpolation
parameters.downsampling: spatial and temporal downsampling by a factor of 2 to reduce noise and computational load

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, downsampled time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Cell segmentation and ROI extraction via singular value decomposition, restricted to clearly identifiable granule cells

parameters.segmentation_method: Suite2p singular value decomposition of spatial/temporal components, followed by manual visual inspection of ROIs in the Suite2p GUI
parameters.cell_selection: granule cells selected based on granule cell layer position and small round soma shape, excluding larger interneuron/mossy cell bodies
parameters.total_cell_counting: Cellpose used on time-averaged images for a subset of sessions, followed by manual inspection to discard non-granule-cell bodies

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell ROI set and extracted fluorescence components

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium transient detection via derivative thresholding with iterative re-baselining

parameters.smoothing: 1 second boxcar filter on Suite2p-extracted traces (C)
parameters.derivative: dF calculated as first-order derivative of the smoothed signal
parameters.threshold: 4 standard deviations above the mean of the smoothed dF vector
parameters.peak_selection: largest-amplitude peak within above-threshold segments lasting >=3 seconds; if multiple peaks within 3 s of each other, only the largest kept
parameters.rebaselining: baseline recalculated after excising 3 s before / 2 s after each transient peak; procedure iterated twice total

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected calcium transient events per cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Synchronization and alignment of behavioral data to calcium imaging data

parameters.sync_method: shared synchronization signal recorded by both the behavior and imaging acquisition computers
parameters.resampling: behavioral data down-sampled to match calcium imaging data rate

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: raw behavioral event traces and calcium transient data
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: time-aligned behavioral and calcium data streams

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially-tuned neurons via a shuffled null distribution of firing-rate-by-position vectors

parameters.running_criterion: continuous running >=2 s duration with peak speed >=5 cm/s
parameters.position_binning: 100 bins of 2 cm, circularly Gaussian-smoothed (SD=5 cm)
parameters.null_distribution: positions circularly shuffled 1000 times per lap to regenerate firing-rate-by-position vectors
parameters.tuning_criterion: fires above mean rate within its field in >=20% of laps (min 3 laps) AND observed firing above 99% of shuffled distribution for >=5 consecutive spatial bins (10 cm)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: calcium transient events aligned to position
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatially-tuned cell classification and firing-rate-by-position tuning curves

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial information scoring, place-field consistency, and place-field onset-lap detection

parameters.spatial_information: Skaggs-style bits/event score computed from the firing-rate-by-position vector, z-normalized against the shuffled null distribution's mean and SD
parameters.consistency_metric: cross-correlation between firing-rate-by-position vectors of the first and second halves of a session's normal laps
parameters.onset_lap_algorithm: iterative lap-by-lap search requiring a transient within the mean field on the current lap and in >=3 of the next 5 laps to call that lap the onset lap

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell spatial information score, field consistency value, and onset lap

pipeline_steps.technique: Multi-session cell tracking and registration using a modified CellReg pipeline

parameters.modification: source code modified to use complete spatial footprints rather than centroids during alignment
parameters.alignment: rigid alignment (translation and rotation) of spatial footprint projections, manually inspected for quality
parameters.matching: probabilistic model estimating expected error rate at different centroid-distance thresholds, refined by a clustering algorithm
parameters.identity_preservation_null: cell IDs randomly permuted 1000 times per pairwise session comparison to build a null distribution for identity preservation rate

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial footprints of segmented cells across sessions
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-session cell identity matches and identity-preservation statistics

pipeline_steps.technique: Rate correlation, population vector correlation, and remapping index analysis across sessions and contexts

parameters.single_cell_correlation: Pearson correlation of spatially-binned averaged firing-rate-by-position vectors between sessions/lap types
parameters.population_vector_correlation: Pearson correlation computed per 2 cm bin across the neural population between contexts
parameters.remapping_index: mean correlation between similar contexts (A-A') minus mean correlation between different contexts (AB and A'B)
parameters.cue_manipulation_cross_correlation: cross-correlation of firing-rate-by-position vectors between normal and shift/omit laps to quantify rate-remapping offset

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell and per-population rate-correlation and remapping index values

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session Bayesian reconstruction of animal position from population calcium activity

parameters.cell_selection: cells cross-registered across all three sessions used as the decoding template, regardless of spatial tuning
parameters.time_bin: 1 second bins; only bins with non-zero transient rate used for decoding
parameters.posterior_normalization: posterior probabilities normalized to sum to one across position bins
parameters.decoding_error: median absolute difference between actual and maximum-posterior-probability position across time bins in a session
parameters.discrimination_and_stability_indices: computed as normalized differences between decoding errors across context pairs (same vs. different context) or session pairs (Day 1 vs. Day 7)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: cross-registered per-cell transient-rate-by-position templates and held-out neural activity
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded position estimates, decoding error, and discrimination/stability indices

pipeline_steps.technique: General hypothesis-testing conventions applied across group comparisons

parameters.group_comparisons: mixed-design repeated-measures two-way ANOVA with Bonferroni's multiple comparisons test
parameters.paired_or_unpaired_means: Wilcoxon rank-sum test (matched samples) or Mann-Whitney test (unpaired samples)
parameters.correlation_tests: linear regression with Pearson's correlation coefficient, followed by Fisher's Z test for between-group comparisons
parameters.analysis_software_split: ANOVA statistics computed in Prism; all other statistics in MATLAB (custom-written routines)
